verdict.rationale: Cua's core purpose is giving agents their own isolated computers. Spaces and the SDK provision Docker/Podman (gVisor when installed), QEMU or Lume VMs, and coding agents can be started inside a Space or sandbox, so testing happens away from the host. A hands-on user also reports using Lume to sandbox Claude on a Mac with reasonable results. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of isolation from production data or snapshot/reset of sandbox state, a documented ephemeral one-shot VM mode (a community member requested this), and clarity on how moving signed-in apps into a Space interacts with real account data.
